Subject: DPIA / Art.28-30 evidence request — subprocessor ledger access exception

Hi Sofia,

Quick intro — I'm Elena (InfoSec, Northside Bank). We're finalizing our DPIA and need a short evidence package from Redwood to close out a control gap flagged by our privacy team. Two asks: 1) an excerpt of the processing ledger (Art.30) showing where Northside Bank customer data is processed and which subprocessors are in scope, and 2) limited read-only access to the subprocessor inventory in a way that avoids exporting raw PII.

We attached our proposed DPA annex with highlighted rows for the subprocessors we want to review. If you can provide an excerpted CSV (redacted where necessary) and a temporary secure view for two people (Paul and myself) that would be ideal. We also need a short note describing the access controls (how long the view is available, what logs are captured, who can see audit trails) so our DPIA can justify the risk acceptance.

Timeline: would it be possible to get the ledger excerpt and control notes by next Wednesday (2025-07-09)? Our procurement milestone is that week and our legal team is waiting on this to sign the DPA addendum.

Attachment: DPA_Annex_Subprocessor_List_2025-07-03.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — let me know if you need a quick 20-min call.

Elena Morales
InfoSec Manager | Northside Bank
elena.morales@northsidebank.com
+1 617-555-0124

Subject: Re: DPIA / Art.28-30 evidence request — subprocessor ledger access exception

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the DPA annex. Looping in Irene (legal/privacy) and Marissa (privacy ops) so we can coordinate evidence and the access model.

High level: we can provide a redacted Art.30 ledger excerpt and a temporary, view-only portal link with audit logging. To scope correctly, two clarifying items would help:
- Which exact data categories (PII / account identifiers / content) are you expecting to see in the ledger excerpt? We typically redact direct identifiers for external reviews.
- Who will require the secure view beyond Paul / you (names + corporate emails)? We need a precise access roster for our access control policy.
- Any contractual requirement that the view must be onshore only? We can restrict access regionally for AP/UK/EU customers.

I've attached our current DPA annex (redwood_dpa_annex_v2.pdf) which calls out the subprocessor inventory and typical redaction rules. Legal will confirm if the DPA addendum needs edits for the temporary access exception.

Plan: Irene / Marissa — can you confirm what evidence we can reasonably ship within the requested window and any additional approvals needed (e.g., security sampling, PI redaction checklist)? If we can commit, I'll create the secure link and a short evidence note describing logging/retention/audit.

Thanks,
Sofia
Director, Privacy & Policy | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_dpa_annex_v2.pdf (pdf)

Thanks, Sofia and Elena — quick legal/privacy note from my side. We are prepared to provide:

1) A redacted Art.30 ledger excerpt (CSV) that includes processor name, processing purpose, legal basis, categories of personal data, and subprocessor role. Direct identifiers (account IDs, user handles) will be redacted unless there is a strongly justified need.

2) A temporary, view-only secure link (accessed via our evidence portal) scoped to two named users. The link will be valid for 7 days by default; we can shorten to a 3-day window if you prefer. All accesses are logged; logs include email, timestamp, IP address, and file actions. We retain access logs for 90 days (can provide a digest for the DPIA).

3) A short attestation document describing the environment, data residency for the exported excerpt, and our redaction methodology.

Prerequisites / exceptions:
- We need a signed DPA addendum that includes the temporary access exception and acknowledges that the ledger excerpt is delivered solely for DPIA purposes and cannot be used for systemic exports. I can draft a minimal addendum and send it as a DocuSign link.
- If Northside requires onshore (US-EAST) read-only viewing only, we can implement that for the scope of this request; however, that may add 1 business day to preparation.

Target delivery: if we receive a signed addendum and the final roster today (Fri 2025-07-04), we can deliver the redacted ledger excerpt and attestation by Tue 2025-07-08 (48–72 hours). If onshore view is required, delivery becomes Wed 2025-07-09.

I'll open a HubSpot ticket and attach the draft addendum. Marissa — can you own evidence export and link provisioning?

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Privacy | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
